howToLook.operate: Open Operate. The first card is the next reversible move, or an instruction to leave the floor alone.
howToLook.evidence: Open Evidence. SpO2 89% on James Carter is consequential and unverified. Batch confirm does not include it.
howToLook.companion: Any follow URL below is a caregiver view of the same plan, without the medical story.
howToLook.map: Command Map. One overlay per room. Opening a room lists visits, required supplies, and Request equipment.

sampleRequests.spokenRound: Pulse 72. SpO2 98%. Blood pressure 118 over 76. Temperature 36.6. Respiratory rate 16.
sampleRequests.stageMove: POST /api/control/stage  — stages the recommended reversible move; refused if it is clinical
